rebind/three placeholders/AT: "INSERT INTO t (a, b, c) VALUES (@p1, @p2, @p3)"
rebind/no placeholders/QUESTION: "SELECT 1"
rebind/no placeholders/DOLLAR: "SELECT 1"
rebind/no placeholders/NAMED: "SELECT 1"
rebind/no placeholders/AT: "SELECT 1"
rebind/question in literal/QUESTION: "SELECT '?' AS q FROM t WHERE a = ?"
rebind/question in literal/DOLLAR: "SELECT '$1' AS q FROM t WHERE a = $2"
rebind/question in literal/NAMED: "SELECT ':arg1' AS q FROM t WHERE a = :arg2"
rebind/question in literal/AT: "SELECT '@p1' AS q FROM t WHERE a = @p2"
rebind/question in line comment/QUESTION: "SELECT * -- a?\nFROM t WHERE a = ?"
rebind/question in line comment/DOLLAR: "SELECT * -- a$1\nFROM t WHERE a = $2"
rebind/question in line comment/NAMED: "SELECT * -- a:arg1\nFROM t WHERE a = :arg2"
rebind/question in line comment/AT: "SELECT * -- a@p1\nFROM t WHERE a = @p2"
rebind/question in block comment/QUESTION: "SELECT /* a? */ * FROM t WHERE a = ?"
rebind/question in block comment/DOLLAR: "SELECT /* a$1 */ * FROM t WHERE a = $2"
rebind/question in block comment/NAMED: "SELECT /* a:arg1 */ * FROM t WHERE a = :arg2"
rebind/question in block comment/AT: "SELECT /* a@p1 */ * FROM t WHERE a = @p2"
rebind/double question escape/QUESTION: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE data ?? 'k' AND a = ?"
rebind/double question escape/DOLLAR: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE data $1$2 'k' AND a = $3"
rebind/double question escape/NAMED: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE data :arg1:arg2 'k' AND a = :arg3"
rebind/double question escape/AT: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE data @p1@p2 'k' AND a = @p3"
rebind/jsonb operators escaped/QUESTION: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE data ??| array['a'] AND data ??& array['b'] AND a = ?"
rebind/jsonb operators escaped/DOLLAR: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE data $1$2| array['a'] AND data $3$4& array['b'] AND a = $5"
rebind/jsonb operators escaped/NAMED: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE data :arg1:arg2| array['a'] AND data :arg3:arg4& array['b'] AND a = :arg5"
rebind/jsonb operators escaped/AT: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE data @p1@p2| array['a'] AND data @p3@p4& array['b'] AND a = @p5"
rebind/mysql escaped quote/QUESTION: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE note = 'don\\'t' AND a = ?"
rebind/mysql escaped quote/DOLLAR: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE note = 'don\\'t' AND a = $1"
rebind/mysql escaped quote/NAMED: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE note = 'don\\'t' AND a = :arg1"
rebind/mysql escaped quote/AT: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE note = 'don\\'t' AND a = @p1"
rebind/like escape clause/QUESTION: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE a LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' AND b = ?"
rebind/like escape clause/DOLLAR: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE a LIKE $1 ESCAPE '\\' AND b = $2"
rebind/like escape clause/NAMED: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE a LIKE :arg1 ESCAPE '\\' AND b = :arg2"
rebind/like escape clause/AT: "SELECT * FROM t WHERE a LIKE @p1 ESCAPE '\\' AND b = @p2"
rebind/bracket identifier/QUESTION: "SELECT [what?] FROM t WHERE a = ?"
rebind/bracket identifier/DOLLAR: "SELECT [what$1] FROM t WHERE a = $2"
rebind/bracket identifier/NAMED: "SELECT [what:arg1] FROM t WHERE a = :arg2"
rebind/bracket identifier/AT: "SELECT [what@p1] FROM t WHERE a = @p2"
rebind/dollar quoted/QUESTION: "SELECT $$?$$ FROM t WHERE a = ?"
rebind/dollar quoted/DOLLAR: "SELECT $$$1$$ FROM t WHERE a = $2"
rebind/dollar quoted/NAMED: "SELECT $$:arg1$$ FROM t WHERE a = :arg2"
rebind/dollar quoted/AT: "SELECT $$@p1$$ FROM t WHERE a = @p2"
rebind/backtick identifier/QUESTION: "SELECT `a?` FROM t WHERE a = ?"
rebind/backtick identifier/DOLLAR: "SELECT `a$1` FROM t WHERE a = $2"
rebind/backtick identifier/NAMED: "SELECT `a:arg1` FROM t WHERE a = :arg2"
rebind/backtick identifier/AT: "SELECT `a@p1` FROM t WHERE a = @p2"

rebind/postgres escape string/DOLLAR: "SELECT E'\\'$1' FROM t WHERE a = $2"
rebind/postgres escape string/NAMED: "SELECT E'\\':arg1' FROM t WHERE a = :arg2"
rebind/postgres escape string/AT: "SELECT E'\\'@p1' FROM t WHERE a = @p2"
